approvals_four_eyes_ck.name: approvals_four_eyes_ck
approvals_four_eyes_ck.value: not "app"."approvals"."requires_four_eyes" or ("app"."approvals"."requester_id" is not null and "app"."approvals"."requester_id" <> "app"."approvals"."actor_id")

cutover_plans_instant_ck.name: cutover_plans_instant_ck
cutover_plans_instant_ck.value:
"app"."cutover_plans"."cutover_instant" is null
        or "app"."cutover_plans"."cutover_instant" = ("app"."cutover_plans"."planned_cutover_date"::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade')

release_gates_approved_ck.name: release_gates_approved_ck
release_gates_approved_ck.value: ("app"."release_gates"."status" = 'APPROVED') = ("app"."release_gates"."approved_by" is not null and "app"."release_gates"."approved_at" is not null)

customer_verifications_note_ck.name: customer_verifications_note_ck
customer_verifications_note_ck.value:
"app"."customer_verifications"."method" not in ('MANUAL_EVIDENCE', 'SUSPENSION', 'REINSTATEMENT')
        or ("app"."customer_verifications"."note" is not null and btrim("app"."customer_verifications"."note") <> '')

identifier_format_rules_retired_ck.name: identifier_format_rules_retired_ck
identifier_format_rules_retired_ck.value: ("app"."identifier_format_rules"."status" = 'RETIRED') = ("app"."identifier_format_rules"."retired_by" is not null and "app"."identifier_format_rules"."retired_at" is not null)

opening_stock_batches_counted_ck.name: opening_stock_batches_counted_ck
opening_stock_batches_counted_ck.value: ("app"."opening_stock_batches"."status" in ('DRAFT')) = ("app"."opening_stock_batches"."counted_by" is null and "app"."opening_stock_batches"."counted_at" is null)

opening_stock_batches_reconciled_ck.name: opening_stock_batches_reconciled_ck
opening_stock_batches_reconciled_ck.value:
("app"."opening_stock_batches"."status" in ('RECONCILED', 'SIGNED_OFF', 'POSTED')) = (
        "app"."opening_stock_batches"."reconciled_by" is not null and "app"."opening_stock_batches"."reconciled_at" is not null
        and "app"."opening_stock_batches"."reconciliation_approval_id" is not null and "app"."opening_stock_batches"."lines_hash" is not null
        and btrim(coalesce("app"."opening_stock_batches"."reconciliation_note", '')) <> '')

opening_stock_batches_signed_ck.name: opening_stock_batches_signed_ck
opening_stock_batches_signed_ck.value:
("app"."opening_stock_batches"."status" in ('SIGNED_OFF', 'POSTED')) = (
        "app"."opening_stock_batches"."signed_off_by" is not null and "app"."opening_stock_batches"."signed_off_at" is not null
        and "app"."opening_stock_batches"."signoff_approval_id" is not null and "app"."opening_stock_batches"."unknown_acknowledged_count" is not null)

opening_stock_batches_posted_ck.name: opening_stock_batches_posted_ck
opening_stock_batches_posted_ck.value: ("app"."opening_stock_batches"."status" = 'POSTED') = ("app"."opening_stock_batches"."posted_at" is not null and "app"."opening_stock_batches"."posted_stock_event_id" is not null)

opening_stock_lines_qty_ck.name: opening_stock_lines_qty_ck
opening_stock_lines_qty_ck.value:
("app"."opening_stock_lines"."status" = 'VERIFIED_QTY' and "app"."opening_stock_lines"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("app"."opening_stock_lines"."status" = 'VERIFIED_ZERO' and "app"."opening_stock_lines"."quantity" = 0)
        or ("app"."opening_stock_lines"."status" = 'UNKNOWN' and "app"."opening_stock_lines"."quantity" is null)

invoice_series_approved_ck.name: invoice_series_approved_ck
invoice_series_approved_ck.value: "app"."invoice_series"."status" not in ('ACCOUNTANT_APPROVED', 'ACTIVE') or "app"."invoice_series"."approval_id" is not null

correction_documents_issued_ck.name: correction_documents_issued_ck
correction_documents_issued_ck.value:
"app"."correction_documents"."status" <> 'ISSUED' or ("app"."correction_documents"."series_id" is not null and "app"."correction_documents"."number" is not null
        and "app"."correction_documents"."issued_at" is not null and "app"."correction_documents"."issued_by" is not null and "app"."correction_documents"."tax_snapshot_id" is not null
        and "app"."correction_documents"."total_gross" is not null)

goods_receipts_posted_ck.name: goods_receipts_posted_ck
goods_receipts_posted_ck.value: ("app"."goods_receipts"."status" = 'POSTED') = ("app"."goods_receipts"."posted_at" is not null and "app"."goods_receipts"."posted_by" is not null)

expenses_supplier_reference_uq.name: expenses_supplier_reference_uq
expenses_supplier_reference_uq.where: "app"."expenses"."supplier_id" is not null and "app"."expenses"."corrects_expense_id" is null

historical_obligations_party_ck.name: historical_obligations_party_ck
historical_obligations_party_ck.value:
("app"."historical_obligations"."direction" = 'RECEIVABLE' and "app"."historical_obligations"."customer_id" is not null and "app"."historical_obligations"."supplier_id" is null)
        or ("app"."historical_obligations"."direction" = 'PAYABLE' and "app"."historical_obligations"."supplier_id" is not null and "app"."historical_obligations"."customer_id" is null)

import_batches_decided_ck.name: import_batches_decided_ck
import_batches_decided_ck.value: ("app"."import_batches"."status" in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED')) = ("app"."import_batches"."decided_by" is not null and "app"."import_batches"."decided_at" is not null)

import_batches_approved_ck.name: import_batches_approved_ck
import_batches_approved_ck.value: ("app"."import_batches"."status" = 'APPROVED') = ("app"."import_batches"."approval_mode" is not null and "app"."import_batches"."approved_row_count" is not null)
